title: EFC Relativistic Action: Field Equations, Perturbation Theory, and Extraction of µ, Σ, η
description: Derives the full field equations of the EFC relativistic action with a non-minimal coupling F(ϕ)R, density-dependent kinetic stiffness K(ρ), and a flow constraint enforced by a Lagrange multiplier. Performs linear perturbation theory in conformal Newtonian gauge and provides closed-form, quasi-static expressions for the effective couplings µ(k, z), Σ(k, z), and slip η(k, z), while showing cT = c and predicting a modified GW amplitude (dL^GW ≠ dL^EM).

modified_einstein.description: Field equations including standard matter, scalar kinetic and potential terms, a tensorial contribution from the flow constraint, and the non-minimal coupling terms.

constraint.description: Flow constraint enforced by the Lagrange multiplier; the entropy field’s d’Alembertian is fixed by the matter density.

response_field.description: Equation for the response field λ capturing the cost of maintaining the entropy ledger in curved spacetime.

qs_delta_phi.description: Quasi-static, sub-horizon slaving of entropy perturbations to matter density perturbations.

slip.description: Gravitational slip sourced by non-minimal coupling and unique EFC flow-constraint/response-field contributions.

mu_sigma_eta_defs.description: Operational definitions of the effective gravitational couplings and slip in the quasi-static regime.

key_results.main_finding: In the quasi-static sub-horizon regime, EFC yields µ < 1, Σ > 1, and η ≠ 1 from a single action, with cT = c exactly and a predicted GW amplitude modification (dL^GW ≠ dL^EM).

sealed_predictions.statement: Exact luminal tensor speed: cT = c for all backgrounds in EFC.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Time-of-flight constraints from multimessenger events (e.g., BNS) comparing GW–EM arrival times at z ≲ 0.1 to |cT/c − 1| > 10^{-15}.

sealed_predictions.statement: Quasi-static modified growth and lensing: µ(k,z) < 1 while Σ(k,z) > 1 for k ≫ aH, with η(k,z) ≠ 1 driven by flow-constraint terms.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint weak-lensing + RSD + clustering analyses inferring µ ≥ 1 and/or Σ ≤ 1 and η ≈ 1 across 0.05 < k < 0.5 h Mpc^{-1}, 0.2 < z < 1.

sealed_predictions.statement: Modified GW amplitude propagation leading to d_L^{GW} ≠ d_L^{EM} due to effective friction from non-minimal/flow sectors.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Standard-siren H0 and cosmology using GW–EM counterparts that constrain |d_L^{GW}/d_L^{EM} − 1| < 0.01 over 0.1 < z < 1.

sealed_predictions.statement: Automatic screening at high density (ρ → ρcrit) via K(ρ) → ∞, recovering GR locally.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Detection of a long-range fifth force or PPN deviations inconsistent with GR in Solar-System/lab tests at levels exceeding current bounds despite high-density environments.

sealed_predictions.statement: Entropy perturbations are slaved to matter perturbations on sub-horizon scales: δϕ ∝ (a^2/k^2) Γ'(ρ̄) δρ.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Evidence for scale-independent clustering or slip inconsistent with the predicted k^{-2} scaling in galaxy–lensing cross-correlations.

kill_criteria: KC1: Any confirmed deviation of GW propagation speed from c at |cT/c − 1| > 10^{-15} from multimessenger events (e.g., BNS) at z ≲ 0.1.
KC2: Standard-siren analyses demonstrating |d_L^{GW}/d_L^{EM} − 1| < 0.01 across 0.1 < z < 1 with systematics under control, incompatible with the predicted amplitude modification.
KC3: Robust joint WL+RSD+clustering inference showing µ(k,z) ≥ 1 over 0.05 < k < 0.5 h Mpc^{-1} and 0.2 < z < 1 at >3σ, contradicting the EFC prediction µ < 1.
KC4: Consistent results across surveys indicating Σ(k,z) ≤ 1 over 0.05 < k < 0.5 h Mpc^{-1} and 0.2 < z < 1 at >3σ, contradicting Σ > 1.
KC5: Measurements finding η(k,z) = 1 within ±0.02 over the same quasi-static scales and redshifts while µ and Σ show no EFC-like pattern, indicating no EFC slip.
KC6: Failure of screening: detection of PPN deviations (e.g., |γ − 1| > 2×10^{-5}) or fifth forces in high-density environments inconsistent with GR recovery despite K(ρ)→∞.
abstract: We derive the complete field equations for the EFC relativistic action, which couples an entropy-flow scalar field phi non-minimally to gravity via F(phi)R, with density-dependent kinetic stiffness K(rho) and a Lagrange-multiplier flow constraint. We perform the full linearisation in conformal Newtonian gauge around an FRW background, and extract closed-form expressions for the effective gravitational couplings mu(k,z) and Sigma(k,z), and the gravitational slip eta(k,z). We show that the combination of non-minimal coupling, kinetic stiffness, and flow constraint naturally produces mu<1, Sigma>1, and eta!=1, consistent with the survival valley identified in the EFC Validation Ledger.

action.name: EFC relativistic action
action.formula: S_EFC = int d^4x sqrt(-g) [ (1/2) M_Pl^2 F(phi) R - (1/2) K(rho) g^{mu nu} d_mu phi d_nu phi - V(phi) - lambda (box phi - Gamma(rho)) ]

non_minimal_coupling.role: Geometry-information coupling: entropy field modifies what curvature means

kinetic_stiffness.role: Cost of moving information diverges at high density (automatic screening)

flow_constraint.role: Entropy flow must balance a ledger tied to matter density

modified_einstein.formula: M_Pl^2 F(phi) G_mu_nu = T^(m) + T^(phi) + T^(V) + T^(lambda) - M_Pl^2 (nabla_mu nabla_nu F - g_mu_nu box F)

stress_tensors.T_phi: K(rho) (d_mu phi d_nu phi - (1/2) g_mu_nu (nabla phi)^2)
stress_tensors.T_lambda: nabla_mu lambda nabla_nu phi + nabla_nu lambda nabla_mu phi - g_mu_nu nabla_a lambda nabla^a phi + lambda (nabla_mu nabla_nu phi - g_mu_nu box phi)

slip_sources: Standard scalar-tensor anisotropic stress from nabla_mu nabla_nu F

scalar_field.formula: nabla_mu (K(rho) nabla^mu phi) + box lambda + (1/2) M_Pl^2 F'(phi) R - V'(phi) = 0

constraint.implication: phi is not a free dynamical field; its d'Alembertian is fixed by matter density

response_field.formula: box lambda = V'(phi) - (1/2) M_Pl^2 F'(phi) R - nabla_mu (K(rho) nabla^mu phi)
response_field.interpretation: lambda records the cost of maintaining the entropy ledger in curved spacetime

perturbation_theory.background: FRW: ds^2 = -dt^2 + a^2(t) delta_ij dx^i dx^j

key_result.interpretation: Entropy perturbation is slaved to matter perturbation

epsilon_K.formula: K(rho_bar) phi_dot_bar a^2 Gamma' / (M_Pl^2 F k^2)

mu.name: Effective Poisson coupling
mu.mechanism: Entropy-stiffness: flow constraint forces delta_phi ~ delta_rho, large K makes this costly

eta.name: Gravitational slip
eta.mechanism: Three slip sources: scalar-tensor, flow-constraint, response-field

sigma.name: Effective lensing coupling
sigma.mechanism: Numerator boosted by slip, denominator suppressed by stiffness
